minigame.MG-29.q.hammer_feather.text: On the Moon, a hammer and a feather are dropped at the same moment. Which lands first?
minigame.MG-29.q.hammer_feather.why: With no air, gravity speeds up every object at the same rate.
minigame.MG-29.q.iss_float.text: Why do astronauts float inside a space station?
minigame.MG-29.q.iss_float.a0: There is no gravity up there
minigame.MG-29.q.iss_float.why: Gravity there is about 90 % of surface gravity: the station and its crew fall around Earth together.
minigame.MG-29.q.coast.text: A spacecraft coasts through empty space with its engine off. What happens to its speed?
minigame.MG-29.q.coast.why: Nothing pushes back in empty space, so a moving object keeps moving (Newton's first law).
minigame.MG-29.q.orbit_speed.text: Two satellites circle Earth, one in a low orbit and one much higher. Which one moves faster?
minigame.MG-29.q.orbit_speed.why: Closer to Earth gravity pulls harder, so a lower orbit has to be flown faster.
minigame.MG-29.q.sideways_drop.text: From the same height, one ball is dropped as another is thrown sideways. Ignore air. Which lands first?
minigame.MG-29.q.sideways_drop.why: Sideways speed does not change how fast a ball falls.
minigame.MG-29.q.moon_pendulum.text: The same pendulum swings on Earth and on the Moon. Where does it swing more slowly?
minigame.MG-29.q.moon_pendulum.why: Weaker gravity pulls it back more gently, so each swing takes longer.
minigame.MG-29.q.rocket_vacuum.text: Can a rocket engine push a spacecraft in empty space, where there is no air?
minigame.MG-29.q.rocket_vacuum.a0: Yes, it pushes on its own exhaust
minigame.MG-29.q.rocket_vacuum.a1: No, it needs air to push against
minigame.MG-29.q.rocket_vacuum.why: Exhaust thrown backwards pushes the rocket forwards (Newton's third law).
minigame.MG-29.q.spin_arms.text: A spinning astronaut pulls both arms in close. What happens to the spin?
minigame.MG-29.q.spin_arms.why: Angular momentum is conserved: pulling mass inwards makes the spin faster.
minigame.MG-29.q.push_off.text: An astronaut floats next to a heavy cargo module and pushes off it. Who moves away faster?
minigame.MG-29.q.push_off.why: Both get the same push in opposite directions; the lighter body gets more speed.
